```{r step-004}
    "`ead`",
    "`recovery`",
    "`lgd <- 1 - recovery`"
  ),
  Financial_role = c(
    "Cumulative default probability of firm $i$ by horizon $T$.",
    "Model score summarizing firm $i$'s credit condition in a scenario; lower values mean weaker credit.",
    "Default threshold; values below this boundary are defaults.",
    "Correlation between credit-state scores before converting them into 0/1 defaults.",

  )
```

```{r step-006}
make_correlation_matrix <- function(n_firms, rho) {
  sigma <- matrix(rho, nrow = n_firms, ncol = n_firms)
  diag(sigma) <- 1
  sigma
}

simulate_latent_credit <- function(n_sims, n_firms, rho, seed = 130575) {
  set.seed(seed)
  MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = n_sims,
    mu = rep(0, n_firms),
    Sigma = make_correlation_matrix(n_firms, rho)
  )
}

make_default_matrix <- function(latent_credit, threshold) {
  latent_credit <= threshold
}

summarize_default_counts <- function(default_matrix) {
  default_count <- rowSums(default_matrix)
  count_table <- as.data.frame(table(default_count))
  names(count_table) <- c("defaults", "frequency")
  count_table$defaults <- as.integer(as.character(count_table$defaults))
  count_table$probability <- count_table$frequency / nrow(default_matrix)
  count_table
}

portfolio_losses <- function(default_matrix, ead, recovery) {
  lgd_amount <- ead * (1 - recovery)
  as.numeric(default_matrix %*% lgd_amount)
}

loss_risk_summary <- function(losses) {
  var_95 <- unname(quantile(losses, 0.95, type = 1))
  var_99 <- unname(quantile(losses, 0.99, type = 1))
  var_999 <- unname(quantile(losses, 0.999, type = 1))

  c(
    expected_loss = mean(losses),
    median_loss = unname(quantile(losses, 0.50, type = 1)),
    var_95 = var_95,
    var_99 = var_99,
    var_999 = var_999,
    es_99 = expected_shortfall(losses, 0.99),
    es_999 = expected_shortfall(losses, 0.999),
    economic_capital_999 = var_999 - mean(losses)
  )
}
```

## 5.4 Two firms and joint defaults

```{r step-033}
source("chapters/05-copulas/helpers/portfolio.R")
```

```{r step-034}
two_firm_sims <- 100000

two_firm_threshold <- default_threshold[5]

two_firm_pd <- pd_cum[5]

two_firm_rhos <- c(-0.5, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.5)

simulate_two_firm_summary <- function(rho) {
  latent <- simulate_latent_credit(
    n_sims = two_firm_sims,
    n_firms = 2,
    rho = rho,
    seed = 130575
  )
  defaults <- make_default_matrix(latent, two_firm_threshold)
  default_a <- defaults[, 1]
  default_b <- defaults[, 2]
  data.frame(
    rho = rho,
    pd_firm_a = mean(default_a),
    pd_firm_b = mean(default_b),
    both_default = mean(default_a & default_b),
    at_least_one = mean(default_a | default_b),
    default_indicator_corr = cor(as.numeric(default_a), as.numeric(default_b))
  )
}

two_firm_numeric <- do.call(rbind, lapply(two_firm_rhos, simulate_two_firm_summary))

two_firm_zero_row <- two_firm_numeric[two_firm_numeric$rho == 0, ]

two_firm_high_row <- two_firm_numeric[two_firm_numeric$rho == 0.5, ]

two_firm_independent_both <- two_firm_pd * two_firm_pd

two_firm_independent_any <- 1 - (1 - two_firm_pd)^2

two_firm_plot_rhos <- c(-0.5, -0.2, 0.2, 0.5)

two_firm_plot_layout_rhos <- c(-0.5, -0.2, 0.2, 0.5)
```

```{r step-035}
two_firm_table <- data.frame(
  Copula_correlation = fmt_num(two_firm_numeric$rho, 1),
  Simulated_PD_A = fmt_pct(two_firm_numeric$pd_firm_a, 2),
  Simulated_PD_B = fmt_pct(two_firm_numeric$pd_firm_b, 2),
  P_both_default = fmt_pct(two_firm_numeric$both_default, 2),
  P_at_least_one = fmt_pct(two_firm_numeric$at_least_one, 2),
  Default_variable_corr = fmt_num(two_firm_numeric$default_indicator_corr, 4)
)

names(two_firm_table) <- c(

  "P(A or B)",
```

```{r table-5-6}
)
```

### From score correlation to default correlation

```{r step-039}
p_a <- two_firm_high_row$pd_firm_a
p_b <- two_firm_high_row$pd_firm_b
p_both <- two_firm_high_row$both_default
indicator_corr_from_frequencies <- (p_both - p_a * p_b) /
  sqrt(p_a * (1 - p_a) * p_b * (1 - p_b))

p_rounded <- round(c(p_a, p_b, p_both), 4)
indicator_corr_rounded <- (p_rounded[3] - p_rounded[1] * p_rounded[2]) /
  sqrt(p_rounded[1] * (1 - p_rounded[1]) *
       p_rounded[2] * (1 - p_rounded[2]))
stopifnot(abs(indicator_corr_from_frequencies -
              two_firm_high_row$default_indicator_corr) < 1e-12)
indicator_corr_from_frequencies
```

```{r step-041}
two_firm_scatter_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(two_firm_plot_data, function(plot_data) {
  rho <- unique(plot_data$rho)
  rho_label <- paste0("rho == ", fmt_num(rho, 1))
  data.frame(

    firm_b = plot_data$firm_b,

  )
}))

  two_firm_scatter_data$rho_label,
  levels = paste0("rho == ", fmt_num(two_firm_plot_layout_rhos, 1))
)

two_firm_panel_data <- unique(
  two_firm_scatter_data[, c("rho", "rho_label")]
)

two_firm_joint_counts <- aggregate(
  joint_default ~ rho_label,
  data = two_firm_scatter_data,
  FUN = sum
```

```{r step-044}
portfolio_sims <- 100000

n_firms_hull <- 10

hull_horizon <- 5

hull_threshold <- default_threshold[hull_horizon]

hull_pd <- pd_cum[hull_horizon]

hull_rho <- hull_example_247_rho

rho_scenarios <- c(0, 0.2, 0.5)

summarize_default_events <- function(default_matrix) {
  default_count <- rowSums(default_matrix)
  n_firms <- ncol(default_matrix)
  c(
    expected_defaults = mean(default_count),
    no_default = mean(default_count == 0),
    at_least_one = mean(default_count >= 1),
    three_or_more = mean(default_count >= 3),
    five_or_more = mean(default_count >= 5),
    all_default = mean(default_count == n_firms)
  )
}

simulate_default_counts <- function(rho) {
  latent <- simulate_latent_credit(
    n_sims = portfolio_sims,
    n_firms = n_firms_hull,
    rho = rho,
    seed = 130575
  )
  defaults <- make_default_matrix(latent, hull_threshold)
  default_count <- rowSums(defaults)
  list(
    latent = latent,
    defaults = defaults,
    default_count = default_count,
    events = summarize_default_events(defaults)
  )
}

default_scenarios <- setNames(
  lapply(rho_scenarios, simulate_default_counts),
  paste0("rho_", rho_scenarios)
)

hull_default_count <- default_scenarios[[paste0("rho_", hull_rho)]]$default_count

hull_distribution <- data.frame(
  Defaults = 0:n_firms_hull,
  Frequency = as.integer(tabulate(hull_default_count + 1, nbins = n_firms_hull + 1))
)

hull_distribution$Probability <- hull_distribution$Frequency / portfolio_sims

event_summary_numeric <- do.call(rbind, lapply(default_scenarios, function(x) x$events))
```

### Averaging losses in the worst tail

```{r step-060}
expected_shortfall <- function(losses, confidence) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(losses), length(losses) > 0,
            all(is.finite(losses)), length(confidence) == 1,
            is.finite(confidence), confidence >= 0, confidence < 1)
  threshold <- unname(quantile(losses, confidence, type = 1))
  excess <- pmax(losses - threshold, 0)
  threshold + mean(excess) / (1 - confidence)
}
```

```{r step-061}
es_losses <- loss_scenarios[[loss_focus_rho_index]]$losses
es_confidence <- 0.99
es_threshold <- unname(quantile(es_losses, es_confidence, type = 1))
es_tail_size <- length(es_losses) * (1 - es_confidence)
es_above_count <- sum(es_losses > es_threshold)
es_tied_count <- sum(es_losses == es_threshold)
es_boundary_weight <- es_tail_size - es_above_count
es_excess_total <- sum(pmax(es_losses - es_threshold, 0))
es_checked <- expected_shortfall(es_losses, es_confidence)
```

### Giving each borrower its own default threshold

Three illustrative borrowers use different five-year PDs, exposures and recoveries.
Analytical expected loss is USD 1,820,000; the simulated mean is checked against its
Monte Carlo standard error. Borrower IDs preserve the column-to-exposure mapping.

```{r heterogeneous-portfolio-inputs}
borrowers <- data.frame(
  borrower = c("A", "B", "C"),
  pd = c(0.02, 0.05, 0.10),
  ead = c(10, 20, 30) * 1e6,
  recovery = c(0.40, 0.50, 0.60)
)
hetero_scores <- simulate_latent_credit(
  n_sims = 100000, n_firms = nrow(borrowers),
  rho = 0.2, seed = 130575
)
colnames(hetero_scores) <- borrowers$borrower
thresholds <- setNames(qnorm(borrowers$pd), borrowers$borrower)
hetero_defaults <- sweep(
  hetero_scores, 2, thresholds[colnames(hetero_scores)], FUN = "<"
)
loss_if_default <- setNames(
  borrowers$ead * (1 - borrowers$recovery), borrowers$borrower
)
hetero_losses <- as.vector(
  hetero_defaults %*% loss_if_default[colnames(hetero_defaults)]
)
```

```{r heterogeneous-portfolio-check}
hetero_el <- sum(borrowers$pd * loss_if_default)
hetero_mean <- mean(hetero_losses)
hetero_mcse <- sd(hetero_losses) / sqrt(length(hetero_losses))
c(analytical_EL = hetero_el, simulated_EL = hetero_mean,
  simulation_SE = hetero_mcse)
```

## 5.8 Tail dependence with a t-copula

```{r step-071}
simulate_t_copula_credit <- function(n_sims, n_firms, rho, df, seed = 130575) {
  set.seed(seed)
  gaussian_latent <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = n_sims,
    mu = rep(0, n_firms),
    Sigma = make_correlation_matrix(n_firms, rho)
  )
  scale_shock <- sqrt(rchisq(n_sims, df = df) / df)
  gaussian_latent / scale_shock
}
```

```{r step-072}
tcopula_sims <- 100000

tcopula_n_firms <- 10

tcopula_rho <- hull_example_247_rho

tcopula_pd <- pd_cum[5]

tcopula_total_ead <- 100e6

tcopula_ead <- rep(tcopula_total_ead / tcopula_n_firms, tcopula_n_firms)

tcopula_recovery <- rep(0.40, tcopula_n_firms)

tcopula_design <- data.frame(
  copula = c("Gaussian", "t-copula", "t-copula"),
  df = c(NA, 10, 4)
)

simulate_tail_dependence_case <- function(copula, df) {
  if (copula == "Gaussian") {
    latent <- simulate_latent_credit(
      n_sims = tcopula_sims,
      n_firms = tcopula_n_firms,
      rho = tcopula_rho,
      seed = 130575
    )
    threshold <- qnorm(tcopula_pd)
  } else {
    latent <- simulate_t_copula_credit(
      n_sims = tcopula_sims,
      n_firms = tcopula_n_firms,
      rho = tcopula_rho,
      df = df,
      seed = 130575
    )
    threshold <- qt(tcopula_pd, df = df)
  }

  defaults <- make_default_matrix(latent, threshold)
  losses <- portfolio_losses(defaults, tcopula_ead, tcopula_recovery)

  list(
    defaults = defaults,
    default_count = rowSums(defaults),
    losses = losses,
    events = summarize_default_events(defaults),
    loss_summary = loss_risk_summary(losses),
    mean_pd = mean(defaults)
  )
}

tcopula_results <- Map(
  simulate_tail_dependence_case,
  tcopula_design$copula,
  tcopula_design$df
)

names(tcopula_results) <- c("Gaussian", "t df = 10", "t df = 4")

tcopula_events <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tcopula_results, function(x) x$events))

tcopula_losses <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tcopula_results, function(x) x$loss_summary))
```

## 5.9 Credit VaR under copula model risk

```{r step-082}
source("chapters/05-copulas/helpers/portfolio.R")
```

```{r step-083}
credit_var_inputs <- list(
  ead = 100e6,
  pd = 0.02,
  recovery = 0.60,
  rho = 0.10,
  confidence = c(0.95, 0.99, 0.999)
)

credit_var_focus <- length(credit_var_inputs$confidence)

credit_var_focus_alpha <- credit_var_inputs$confidence[credit_var_focus]
```

### From the common credit factor to a loss percentile

```{r step-084}
factor_examples <- c(0, qnorm(1 - credit_var_focus_alpha))
conditional_pd_examples <- pnorm(
  (qnorm(credit_var_inputs$pd) -
     sqrt(credit_var_inputs$rho) * factor_examples) /
    sqrt(1 - credit_var_inputs$rho)
)
conditional_pd_examples
```

```{r step-085}
vasicek_default_rate <- function(pd, rho, confidence) {
  pnorm(
    (qnorm(pd) + sqrt(rho) * qnorm(confidence)) /
      sqrt(1 - rho)
  )
}

vasicek_credit_var <- function(ead, pd, recovery, rho, confidence) {
  ead * (1 - recovery) * vasicek_default_rate(pd, rho, confidence)
}
```

```{r step-086}
credit_var_rate <- vasicek_default_rate(
  credit_var_inputs$pd,
  credit_var_inputs$rho,
  credit_var_inputs$confidence
)

credit_var_loss <- vasicek_credit_var(
  credit_var_inputs$ead,
  credit_var_inputs$pd,
  credit_var_inputs$recovery,
  credit_var_inputs$rho,
  credit_var_inputs$confidence
)

credit_expected_loss <- credit_var_inputs$ead *
  (1 - credit_var_inputs$recovery) *
  credit_var_inputs$pd



credit_var_q_pd <- qnorm(credit_var_inputs$pd)

credit_var_q_conf <- qnorm(credit_var_inputs$confidence[credit_var_focus])

credit_var_numerator <- credit_var_q_pd +
  sqrt(credit_var_inputs$rho) * credit_var_q_conf

credit_var_denominator <- sqrt(1 - credit_var_inputs$rho)

credit_var_standardized <- credit_var_numerator / credit_var_denominator
```

### Comparing capital under alternative copulas

```{r step-100}
credit_model_sims <- 200000

credit_model_n_names <- 1000
```

```{r step-101}
simulate_granular_gaussian_loss <- function(n_sims, n_names, ead, pd, recovery, rho, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  systematic_factor <- rnorm(n_sims)
  conditional_pd <- pnorm(
    (qnorm(pd) - sqrt(rho) * systematic_factor) / sqrt(1 - rho)
  )
  default_count <- rbinom(n_sims, n_names, conditional_pd)
  default_count * (ead / n_names) * (1 - recovery)
}

simulate_granular_t_loss <- function(n_sims, n_names, ead, pd, recovery, rho, df, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  systematic_factor <- rnorm(n_sims)
  scale_shock <- sqrt(rchisq(n_sims, df = df) / df)
  conditional_pd <- pnorm(
    (qt(pd, df = df) * scale_shock - sqrt(rho) * systematic_factor) /
      sqrt(1 - rho)
  )
  default_count <- rbinom(n_sims, n_names, conditional_pd)
  default_count * (ead / n_names) * (1 - recovery)
}
```

### Checking the precision of the tail comparison

```{r step-109}
precision_inputs <- list(
  n_sims = credit_model_sims, n_names = credit_model_n_names,
  ead = credit_var_inputs$ead, pd = credit_var_inputs$pd,
  recovery = credit_var_inputs$recovery, rho = credit_var_inputs$rho
)
precision_seeds <- 130576:130595
credit_tail_repeats <- t(vapply(precision_seeds, function(seed) {
  gaussian_loss <- do.call(simulate_granular_gaussian_loss,
    c(precision_inputs, list(seed = seed)))
  t_loss <- do.call(simulate_granular_t_loss,
    c(precision_inputs, list(df = 4, seed = seed)))
  gaussian_es <- expected_shortfall(gaussian_loss, 0.999)
  t_es <- expected_shortfall(t_loss, 0.999)
  c(Gaussian = gaussian_es, Student = t_es,
    Difference = t_es - gaussian_es)
}, numeric(3)))
```

```{r step-110}
tail_precision_mean <- colMeans(credit_tail_repeats)
tail_precision_sd <- apply(credit_tail_repeats, 2, sd)
tail_precision_se <- tail_precision_sd / sqrt(length(precision_seeds))
```

```{r table-5-22}
  `SE of mean` = fmt_num(tail_precision_se / 1e6, 3),
  check.names = FALSE
```
